popCulture.title: Lycurgus of Thrace
popCulture.description: Edonian king who drove Dionysus' nurses with an ox-goad — Homer's first persecutor of the god, blinded afterward.

popCulture.title: Iliad
popCulture.description: Iliad 6 — Diomedes recalls Lycurgus' hubris — the epic warning not to chase Dionysus into Thetis' sea.

popCulture.title: The Bacchae
popCulture.creator: Euripides
popCulture.description: Euripides' Theban climax keeps the Lycurgus pattern — the king who insults the god and pays with his house.
